purpose: Marks a person as a favourite. Off, it is an outlined star; on, the star fills with candle gold, so the change is a shape as well as a colour.
example: <button type="button" class="star" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Add Maya K. to favourites"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3.6l2.6 5.3 5.8.8-4.2 4.1 1 5.8-5.2-2.7-5.2 2.7 1-5.8-4.2-4.1 5.8-.8z"/></svg></button>
